title: Vanishing of an arbitrary module map at one affine chart stage
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R a diagram of commutative rings and c an affine limit cone of Spec(R) [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Let f:X_i→Spec(R_i) be any morphism and i≤j≤k. Let U be an open cover of X_j with affine charts and fix a chart a. Put V=U pulled back to X_k. For quasi-coherent modules F,G on V.X a, with F of finite type and G of finite presentation [pqf-def-coherent], let δ:F→G. If the pullback of δ along the chart projection from the limit is zero, then for some l≥k its pullback along the canonical refinement chart map from l to k [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions] is zero. This concludes at one stage only; it has no transition system or coherence hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 01ZR (3), first proof (affine case), transported through the canonical chart pullback squares; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZR

proof.text: Let V be U pulled back to X_k and W=V.X a. Its structural map is b=V.f a followed by pullback.snd to Spec(R_k). isPullback_baseChangeMap and stability of IsAffineHom under base change prove that X_k→X_j is affine; the affine-chart pullback instance proves W affine, hence b quasi-compact. Keep the exact self-stage arrow t₀=Spec(R.map(homOfLE(k≤k))) and prove t₀=id. Construct F₀,G₀,δ₀ by tensor pullback along p=pullback.fst b t₀. Use tensorPullback_isFiniteType for F₀; use the tensor/native adjoint comparison and the proved source instances isQuasicoherent_pullback and isFinitePresentation_pullback for the other properties.

Prove the comparison for any cartesian square IsPullback q s b t, with t≫t₀=t. Let g=baseChangeMap b (Over.homMk t) from the t-base change to the t₀-base change. Its composite with p is pullback.fst b t. nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction, followed by Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq, compare each tensor pullback with native pullback. Naturality of a natural isomorphism and cancellation of its component isomorphisms preserve and reflect the equation map δ=0. pullbackComp identifies the composite pullback. The cartesian square gives isoPullback with hom followed by the first projection equal to q. Pullback along this scheme isomorphism reflects zero: pull back further along its inverse, use pullbackComp and inv_hom_id. Thus base change of δ₀ is zero if and only if native pullback of δ along q is zero. These are the proved private helpers in the delivered module; no existence witness for a module is chosen.

The pullback-cover square for V along overlapLimitMap, pasted vertically with isPullback_baseChangeMap, is cartesian over b and c.π_k. Apply the previous comparison to hδ. Apply finitePresentation_zero_map_descent R c hc k b k (le_refl k) to the constructed models and δ₀; obtain l≥k and its base-change zero equation. For the finite-stage chart, IsPullback.of_right cancels the original chart square from the later chart square: overlapRefinementHom_map and overlapRefinementHom_comp verify the two projections and overlapStageMap_comp verifies the base composite. Paste this square vertically with the finite-stage base-change square. The same comparison turns the supplied zero equation into vanishing along the required overlapRefinementHom. All arguments also cover zero modules, empty charts, and singleton directed systems.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01ZR (3), first proof (affine vanishing); canonical chart comparison glue formalized using pullback pasting, adjoint uniqueness, and naturality. Tensor pullback is the construction of Stacks Tag 0095.

theorem finitePresentation_chart_map_zero_eventually
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    [∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)] (a : U.I₀) (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k)
    (F G : ((U.pullback₁ (overlapStageMap R f hij hjk)).X a).Modules)
    (hF_ft : F.IsFiniteType) (hF_qc : F.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hG_fp : G.IsFinitePresentation) (hG_qc : G.IsQuasicoherent)
    (δ : F ⟶ G)
    (hδ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ (overlapStageMap R f hij hjk))
        (overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans hjk)) a)).map δ = 0) :
    ∃ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l),
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (overlapRefinementHom U (overlapStageMap R f hij hjk)
          (overlapStageMap R f hij (hjk.trans hkl))
          (overlapStageMap R f (hij.trans hjk) hkl)
          (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkl) a)).map δ = 0
